text: 宇树科技董事长、总经理兼首席技术官王兴兴表示，高性能通用机器人同时面向行业级和消费级的应用。对于行业级应用，电力、消防等已实现商业成熟应用的客户更倾向于具有成功落地案例的企业合作，未来在工业生产、医疗保健、应急救援等领域的应用也将由头部企业主导，市场头部效应显著。对于消费级应用，大量消费者优先考虑知名品牌的机器人产品，市场教育、品牌认知培养、品牌生态建设等都是竞争的关键环节，头部企业加速构建“硬件+软件+服务”三位一体的生态建设，逐步完善的生态黏性将使新品牌机器人的获客成本激增。（上证报）
text_en: Wang Xingxing, Chairman, General Manager and CTO of Unitree Robotics, said high-performance general-purpose robots serve both industrial and consumer applications. For industrial applications, customers in areas like power and firefighting, which have achieved commercial maturity, prefer companies with successful implementation cases, and future applications in industrial production, healthcare, and emergency rescue will be led by top players, with significant head-firm effects. For consumer applications, many consumers prioritize robots from well-known brands, making market education, brand awareness cultivation, and brand ecosystem building key competitive factors, as leading companies accelerate the construction of a 'hardware + software + service' integrated ecosystem, and increasingly refined ecosystem stickiness will sharply raise customer acquisition costs for new robot brands. (Shanghai Securities News)
